description: Exchanges an authorization code for an OAuth 2.0 access token and refresh token that can be used to access AWS services from developer tools and applications.

researchLinks.description: AWS Login Phishing Attack: How Attackers Exploit New Authentication
Phishing for AWS credentials via the new AWS login flow

securityImplications: Attackers might use CreateOAuth2Token to exchange a phished authorization code from the AWS login cross-device flow for OAuth 2.0 access and refresh tokens, giving them persistent access to the victim's AWS account.
